originalTitle: Sharp gradient bounds and step selection under relative errors
abstract: We study constant-step gradient descent when each computed gradient has a deterministic relative error below one. An explicit convex function of two variables attains the published intermediate one-step bound, completing its exact worst-case curve and determining its unique optimal step. The error in an optimal attaining instance is perpendicular to the computed direction. For multiple updates, we determine the exact asymptotic worst-case minimum squared gradient norm under an initial function-gap condition. A local interpolation certificate with a telescoping gradient correction gives the upper bound; explicit trajectories attain its leading coefficient. We obtain the exact asymptotic minimax step and convergence of asymptotically minimizing step sequences. For the last gradient, a staged family in logarithmically growing dimensions rules out a dimension-independent O(1/N ) bound at every fixed normalized step 0 < h ≤ 1. In the plane, we prove such a bound for 0 < h ≤ 1/(1 + δ), including its endpoint. The proof controls gradient-magnitude records along the actual polygonal path and also gives a continuous-time estimate.
limitation: 高维障碍不是一个固定函数的无限坏轨道。 固定二维h=1仍未解决。 对接受终稿的猜想状态必须保留版本限定。
reasons: 一步精确曲线、最佳历史梯度的精确渐近及末梯度维数障碍形成多个实质增量。
说明相对误差下最优步长、末点性能与维数的关系，影响一般不精确一阶法的保证。
真实全局取等函数、统一极小极大边界窗口和二维梯度射线纪录引理具有较强技术含量。
凸光滑任意相对误差；末点坏例允许维数随时域增长，二维正结果仅指定小步长。
负正结果、精确常数及连续对照自足；特定接受稿历史与二维h=1问题仍未闭合。

originalTitle: The sharp convergence range and boundary rates of generalized Fast Krasnoselskii–Mann iteration
abstract:
We study the generalized Fast Krasnoselskii–Mann iteration for a nonexpansive mapping on a real Hilbert space. The known fast parameter interval is 1 < θ < α − 1, with α > 2. We determine its universal convergence range for positive θ and distinguish this range from the acceleration boundary.

• For each α > 1, weak convergence for every nonexpansive map with a fixed point, every σ > 0 and every initial pair holds exactly when 1 ≤ θ < α. The case θ = 1 is the known Halpern boundary.

• At θ = α − 1 with α > 2, the residual and velocity are O(1/k). In the higher band max{1, α − 1} < θ < α, their sharp general order is O(k^{−(α−θ)}).

• Below θ = 1, one fixed nonlinear firmly nonexpansive map has an unbounded orbit for each parameter pair, with σ = α. In finite dimensions, strictly averaged maps with nonempty bounded fixed-point sets instead approach that set. Reflections give the upper failure and exact rate sharpness.

• At the corresponding continuous acceleration boundary, monotone Lipschitz operators give weak trajectory convergence and O(1/t) residual and velocity bounds.

For a convex proximal map with a fixed point, residuals and steps vanish for all positive α, θ and σ; a finite-dimensional unique minimizer gives strong convergence. We use two-state energies and scalar averaging, and prove common finite limits for scaled residual and velocity norms.
limitation: Hilbert坏例不直接搬到有限维。 特殊近端分支仍需继续核查更广既有文献。
reasons: 给原广义FastKM普遍弱收敛参数的必要充分范围，连同速率端点、坏例及特殊算子分界。
对广泛不动点加速方案形成参数图谱，解决已明确保留的临界问题。
双状态能量、固定非线性Hilbert坏例和近端结构分析克服不同困难。
一般Hilbert非扩张映射、任意初始对；并区分有限维平均及近端子类。
正反阈值和尖锐速率较完整，经典Halpern及已知连续旋转不能重复计新。

originalTitle: Finite length of ordinary alternating regret matching in potential games
abstract: Ordinary regret matching retains signed cumulative regrets, including negative entries that can delay a strategy change for a long time. We prove that its deterministic cyclic trajectory in every finite exact potential game has finite total strategy length and converges to one Nash equilibrium, from every initial mixed profile with zero cumulative regrets. The positive parts of the regret vectors also have finite total length. A one-step potential budget controls the extra contribution from coordinates emerging from negative memory. This yields a weighted gradient estimate for the polynomial potential lifted to a fixed product of spheres. The analytic gradient inequality then makes the square roots of the cycle gains summable. The result concerns the current profiles and does not assert bounded signed regrets or a uniform complexity bound; the known exponential transient remains compatible with convergence.
limitation: 不解决同步RM或一般非多线性约束优化。 有限长度常数依赖实际首次激活。
reasons: 证明普通signed RM循环交替策略整列收敛及有限长度，解决正式文仍提出的渐近问题。
覆盖有限精确势博弈的基础无参数学习规则，不只一个特殊博弈。
新激活负遗憾记忆项、正部预算和球面解析梯度控制突破signed状态不紧问题。
任意有限玩家/动作及初始策略，要求零遗憾和固定循环；不覆盖同步或随机反馈。
正部与策略长度、Nash识别及负遗憾无界例完整；无统一复杂度。

originalTitle: Last iterate convergence and entropy limits of optimistic matrix multiplicative weights
abstract: We prove last iterate convergence of raw optimistic matrix multiplicative weights in finite-dimensional bilinear quantum zero-sum games in two regimes. In arbitrary complex matrix dimensions, existence of one strictly complementary Nash pair suffices for both entire state sequences to converge to one Nash pair with the same supports. Forward relative entropy from that selected limit tends to zero; the strict witness need not be the selected pair. For one qubit per player, state convergence holds without strict complementarity, uniqueness or a full-rank equilibrium. Both results use maximally mixed initialization and one sufficiently small fixed step. The arbitrary-dimensional proof combines an optimistic entropy estimate with a unitary commutator bound and controlled spectral leakage at singular limits. On a fixed non-strict qubit game from the literature, all four forward relative entropies instead converge to the same strictly positive limit despite state convergence. An exact score ratio gives an explicit positive lower bound. On that same orbit, state error has exact order k^{−1/3} and Nash gap has exact order k^{−1}, with leading constants determined by the positive entropy limit. A fixed qutrit–qubit example further selects a mixed state on a nonunique singular Nash face despite the absence of any strictly complementary pair; both selected forward entropies vanish. No rate or selection formula uniform over games is asserted.
limitation: 规范初值和小步长限制仍在。 一个高维非严格互补例不代表全部此类。
reasons: 原非正则化OMMWU取得双qubit无严格互补整列收敛，并展示状态收敛但正熵极限非零。
补平均策略到真实末点的差距，揭示奇异矩阵边界下熵和状态的分离。
非交换面外质量、压缩对数及精确幂律需要超出单纯形论证的工具。
双qubit全部游戏；高维要求存在严格互补见证，未解决所有高维奇异游戏。
两个全局定理与非严格互补实例形成完整链条，步长常数保守。

originalTitle: Finite Length and Multiscale Boundary Selection in Burg Mirror Descent
abstract: We prove a general-clock finite-length theorem for inexact Burg descent on a product of positive free coordinates and a simplex. For positive steps tending to zero with divergent accumulated time T, actual capture of the free block and ordinary dual residual O(βT⁻³ᐟ²) imply convergence to a unique convex analytic minimum, an inverse-clock objective bound, finite physical length, and exact literal boundary profiles. No square-summability or regularity of successive steps is required. The proof combines inherited cone-adapted static geometry with a residual-aware exact discrete clock argument. We verify its hypotheses for nonlinear positive-concave perspectives: a unique secondary minimum is selected on a harmonic clock; a fully flat secondary face with positive transverse quadratic form yields a unique tertiary minimum on any face, including zero gaps and degenerate supported curvature. Exact reciprocal order supplies a complementary nonunique support criterion. An explicit finite-depth family has sharp iterated-logarithmic physical tails, separating rate-free length from uniform tail claims. All perspective reductions retain the original normalized map and ambient step restriction.
limitation: 一般定理仍要求自由坐标的实际捕获，不能作为任意归一化均可调用的黑箱；普通对偶误差的 3/2 预算未证明最优。三级选择依赖全投影平坦与横向一致正定，尚未覆盖奇异横向形式、一般弯曲次级极小集或非唯一三级极小点；一般非唯一凸解析问题的选择仍未解决。
reasons: 一般时钟、普通对偶误差、锥适配真实Gram与物理投影的组合形成明确技术增量；二次归一化及精确尾长可核验。静态旗标、KL、线性屏障路径与对数层级本身是已有思想，已扣除重复计分。
回答Burg无限距离边界上的点选择、有限路径与慢尾行为，超出只给目标差的保证；但尚未覆盖一般非唯一凸解析问题，也没有证据认定解决了公认重大开放问题。
难点集中在源端退化度量中的误差闭合、先捕获再缩放、移动面比较和多层实际时钟，不是公式数量。关键估计足以跨越形式连续极限与离散真轨道之间的差距。
任意维唯一凸解析极小点允许任意间隙及支撑退化，步长灵活；同时固定Burg核、唯一性、真实自由捕获和明确误差预算限制了主结果，三级应用又有特殊横向几何。
正文与补充形成完整依赖，包含非排序例、混合行失秩例、中央路径对照和任意有限级联。没有拿未证明的一般归一化接口充当定理；剩余研究方向被明确列为范围之外。

originalTitle: Sharp convergence and phase selection for the primal-first Chambolle–Pock map at θ = 1/4
abstract: For the literal primal-first Chambolle–Pock iteration with extrapolation 1/4, we prove weak convergence for τ σ∥L∥^{2} < 8/3 and boundedness at equality. At the endpoint, every trajectory selects a single two-cycle: its even and odd subsequences converge weakly to the two states of an exact orbit, whose midpoint is a saddle point. Adjacent midpoints and ordinary Cesàro averages converge to that same saddle point. In finite dimensions all these convergences are strong. We characterize every endpoint two-cycle and prove that strict convexity of either function excludes nonconstant cycles. A four-pair storage certificate is given with complete rational coefficients and a reproducible exact-arithmetic verifier. Its alternating kernel explains both the sharp threshold and the endpoint behavior.
limitation: 固定θ=1/4，不能外推其他参数或声称普遍算法最优性。 与P002四分之一支高度包含；应减少重复论文计数。 有限维强收敛不意味着无限维强收敛，未给统一端点相位速率。
reasons: 把θ=1/4的普遍严格阈值闭合到8/3，并进一步得到端点二周期相位选择及完整幅值条件；比单独扩大充分步长有更多动力学内容。
回答标准原CP在自然稳定边界究竟如何运行，区分解的中点与实际二周期相位；对理解端点失败和平均输出具有明确意义。
有理证书仅是第一环；端点半定核、中点KKT、支撑松弛可和及无限维偶奇相位唯一选择是非平凡部分。
覆盖一般Hilbert空间、非光滑闭凸目标和一般有界耦合，端点分类含不取范数的算子；仍固定一个θ。
严格内区间、边界捕获、二周期全分类、相位选择、严格凸排除及超阈值实例相互支持，形成完整研究问题。

originalTitle: The sharp product region for Chambolle–Pock four-cycles
abstract: For every positive extrapolation parameter, we classify the stepsize products admitting an orbit of least period four for the literal primal-first Chambolle–Pock recurrence. Two universal lower bounds are necessary: one is strict and follows from a nonnegative combination of cyclic subgradient inequalities; the other follows from opposite-displacement inequalities and a Gram bound. Three-dimensional indicator polytopes realize every product satisfying both bounds, with an existing saddle point and an explicit initialization. The infimum changes from unattained to attained at a precisely determined parameter, with the crossover itself unattained. The argument retains all temporal Fourier modes and applies to arbitrary finite-dimensional convex problems. A separate zero-parameter corollary identifies a discontinuity of the infimum. This is a finite-period classification, not a convergence theorem. No novelty claim is made.
limitation: 并非CP普遍收敛阈值。 通用Fourier机制与P011共享，不能另计为第二套通用方法。
reasons: 得到所有有限维凸CP最小四周期的完整乘积集合，严格端点与可达端点的区别不是单例能说明的。
说明二周期退化会改变四周期集合的闭性，丰富算法边界机制；不直接扩展收敛保证。
完整保留交替模态，以非负证书排除低乘积，再用混合模态构造达到性。
全θ>0、任意有限维耦合与凸目标，另处理θ=0；只限周期4。
两个必要界、严格性、三维真实实现和零外推均完整。

originalTitle: An exact finite-period Fourier–SOC criterion for primal-first Chambolle–Pock cycles
abstract: For every integer m ≥ 2, every real extrapolation parameter, and every positive actual stepsize product, we characterize the existence of nonconstant m-periodic orbits of the literal primal-first Chambolle–Pock map by a finite second-order-cone system. Necessity holds for arbitrary finite-dimensional real Hilbert spaces, linear couplings, and proper closed convex functions. Every feasible point is realized by two convex-hull indicators in dimension 2(m − 1), with the prescribed product, a saddle pair, and literal paired initialization. All 2(m − 1) cyclic inequalities are retained, including the real Nyquist mode and degenerate Gram data. Least period is characterized by the greatest common divisor of the combined primal and dual frequency support; its strict support conditions are distinguished from closed conic feasibility. We prove compactness, positive product bounds, product-ray properties, and exact scalar consequences for period two and zero extrapolation. These are finite-cycle results, not global convergence assertions. No priority or originality claim is made.
limitation: 大周期的显式最优值尚不由判据自动获得。 存在性结论不说明吸引域或随机初值行为。
reasons: 把CP任意有限周期存在性化为显式Fourier–SOC系统，含最小周期gcd及退化实现；超出泛化SDP周期搜索的具体结构化结论。
提供统一可计算的有限周期判据，可系统整理失稳见证及排除结果；不能判定所有非周期失败。
循环凸性、频率Gram锥、全法锥反向实现、支持算术和紧性需要完整闭合。
任意m、实θ和有限维凸目标/耦合，维数自由；不限定规则平面轨道。
必要充分、维数界、最小周期、闭性、射线和两个精确特例相互完整。

originalTitle: Dual curvature and stability in Chambolle Pock dynamics
abstract:
We study the literal primal-first Chambolle–Pock iteration with extrapolation 1/8 and a quadratic dual objective. Our main extension allows arbitrary bounded anisotropic dual curvature and nonseparable convex primal objectives on real Hilbert spaces. For identity coupling, σ = 1, Q ⪰ (w^{−1} − 1)I and 47/50 ≤ w < 1, the sharp class-wide strict cap is 8(1 + w + w^{2})/(w(9w − 1)). A single asymmetric three-tap scalar graph multiplier works across all spectral modes; a dimension-free soft-IQC continuation proves actual strong convergence, square-summable errors and residuals, summable anchored gaps, and uniform true-restart bounds yielding anchored geometric convergence. Consequently 0 < r ≤ 3 is the included sharp curvature-independent cap over all bounded coercive Q: r = 3 lies strictly below each instance’s cap. Sharp failure uses an admissible scalar subclass, not every fixed anisotropic operator. No rate uniform in vanishing coercivity or extension to Q = 0, unbounded Q, general coupling or incremental contraction is asserted.

For identity coupling, scalar resolvent parameter 0 < q < 1, and every proper lower-semicontinuous convex primal objective on a real Hilbert space, we prove the complete class-universal sharp product range. Its open cap is 8(1 + q)/(5q) for q ≤ (√105 − 3)/8 and 8(1 + q + q^{2})/(q(9q − 1)) above that switch. Every strictly admissible product has strong paired convergence, error and port square summability, and a uniform true-restart tail bound in the ordinary physical pair norm. This gives geometric convergence and positive-output objective and residual estimates. At and above the cap, actual linear or fixed-objective period-three orbits provide counterexamples. For general bounded coupling we distinguish four sufficient certificate regimes: the exact three-history ansatz radius, an analytic mixed two-tap cap, a rational closed cap 337/100, and a three-tap closed cap 159/50 only for σ = 1 and Q = I/19. Their conclusions are weak primal and strong dual and coupling-image convergence, with their stated summability. The three-history curvature-dependent cap and its quantitative consequences remain separate; no new general-coupling rate is inferred from the mixed or three-tap certificates. Explicit scalar constants, affine boundary dynamics, fixed metrics, restricted robustness, multiplier comparisons, and actual period-three, four and five classifications retain their individual scopes. The storage and multiplier methodology is established prior art; theorem-level comparison with Wu–Ma remains unresolved.
limitation: 原稿缺特定证书，当前仍是有条件通过。 不同假设下的阈值、指定供给半径和速率混杂，阅读成本高。 吴–马全文未取得，最接近比较仍有不确定性。
reasons: 标量正对偶曲率的完整尖锐范围、一般非交换耦合共同乘子与鲁棒扰动形成实质进展；IQC/KYP及自动能量框架已有。
把非二次原始目标、曲率带和实际失稳阈值联系起来，比孤立参数例子更系统；仍固定外推1/8及以二次对偶为核心。
商系统稳定、核修复、软IQC因果闭合、Hilbert提升及统一重启速率技术较深；175页与证书条数本身不加分。
原始目标可非光滑、非可分离，一般耦合无需与Q交换；最完整锐相图在标量曲率及恒等耦合，不能扩写为一般算子的锐界。
多条核心链已独立闭合，但原交付缺特定存储及JSON，虽有本次替代证书，尚须正式补入；结构也过于庞杂。
reviewNote: 原稿存在需要修复的证明环节；本次评分以审稿报告给出的修复方案为前提。此处 PDF 为原稿，尚未合入修复。

originalTitle: Minimum norm selection and damping thresholds for critically regularized inertial methods
abstract: We study inertial gradient and forward–backward methods with extrapolation coefficient 1 − a/k and Tikhonov coefficient b/(sk^{2}). On a real Hilbert space, for a > 3, b > 0, and sL < 1, every orbit converges strongly to the minimum norm minimizer, with objective residual o(k^{−2}) and discrete velocity o(k^{−1}), without geometric summability or an eventual ball condition. At a = 3, targeted Attouch–Czarnecki summability gives strong selection and O(k^{−2}), O(k^{−1}) rates. Relative flatness permits lower damping for smooth objectives. In finite dimensions with bounded sublevels, growth of order 2 ≤ q < 4 only transverse to the affine hull of the minimizer set gives strong selection and both little-o rates for every a > 1; quartic transverse growth is also sufficient at a = 3. Ambient interior is included as a vacuous-growth case. Explicit coupled examples violate targeted summability, and a shifted quartic example fails relative flatness at every minimizer. A fixed smooth convex Moreau envelope has universal selection exactly for a ≥ 3/2, with both little-o rates including equality and prescribed equal-unit failures below it. At equality, its corresponding continuous equation fails selection from the same initial position with zero velocity. A separate scalar quartic orbit selects zero while failing the two little-o rates. An elementary coercive example shows that the universal range cannot include a ≤ 1. For positive-semidefinite quadratics, universal convergence is characterized exactly: no spectral condition is needed for a > 1; injectivity is necessary and sufficient for a = 1; and coercivity is necessary and sufficient for 0 < a < 1. In the last regime, a noncoercive injective operator admits an unbounded zero-velocity orbit despite having a unique minimizer.
limitation: a=3一般情况仍依赖附加条件。 多个几何子类体量大，应突出共同问题，避免把每个阈值单独计作一项突破。
reasons: 完成原显式临界k⁻²正则化的强选择，并分离阻尼、几何和速率阈值；不是首次提出Tikhonov选点。
将临界值衰减与实际最小范数选择同时闭合，对惯性正则化理论有明确意义。
一般Hilbert有符号能量、谱端点和固定非二次反例需要不同证明机制，不能仅靠连续模型类比。
主定理覆盖一般Hilbert光滑/复合凸问题、任意初值；精细阈值的若干分支附加有限维或增长条件。
正结果、附加几何与反例相互支持；未把a=3或低阻尼的一般问题冒称全部解决。

originalTitle: Nongeometric primal convergence of an inertial hinge algorithm
abstract: We give a finite-dimensional counterexample to a universal eventual linear rate for the primal iterates of the projected inertial dual-hinge algorithm. The signed data are linearly separable and the two initial dual states are equal and nonzero. We treat both the allowed maximal step and the fixed strict step γ = 1−10^{−30} when the Lipschitz constant is one. The minimum-norm primal separator is unique, whereas the dual solution set is a triangle. For each of these two steps, a compactness argument selects one fixed initialization whose trajectory has infinitely many isolated face contacts separated by geometrically increasing waiting times. At actual integer iterates, the primal error has a polynomial subsequence lower bound and therefore satisfies no eventual R-linear estimate. The construction uses the unchanged algorithm and a prescribed decreasing box schedule. At the strict step, the proof retains both range-memory states and controls them relative to the shrinking contact scale at every return. At the maximal step, the mechanism is Nesterov-extrapolated alternating projection between an affine space and an orthant. The result does not cover every strict step or the zero-vector initialization. The lower-bound exponent is deliberately conservative.
limitation: 零向量初始化在该实例下可能立即达到原始最优。 严格步长离上界极近，缺乏大范围稳健性结论。
reasons: 在固定可分数据和固定严格步长上构造真正非几何的原始收敛，排除把已有线性速率直觉普遍移植到惯性版。
解释原始论文惯性上界与非惯性线性界之间可以存在本质差异，而非必然是证明技术不够。
无限次真实壁面接触、时钟递推、严格步长记忆和单一参数的非退出选择相当精细。
仅一个11维构造、两个指定步长及选择的非零等初值；不覆盖零初值或典型数据。
先证实际原始收敛再给无穷子列下界，逻辑完整；指数不是尖锐渐近，初始化由存在性选取。

originalTitle: Lyapunov energies for convergence and alternation in IGAHD
abstract: We give explicit Lyapunov certificates for four regimes of the original IGAHD recurrence. In the scalar case with α = 4 and s = 1, a phase energy at β = 9/4 proves global convergence and finite length for C^{2} potentials with 1/100 ≤ f^{′′} ≤ 1. For coercive C^{2} potentials with 0 ≤ f^{′′} ≤ 1 and minimizer interval [−1, 1], two weighted endpoint energies prove point convergence without a positive curvature lower bound. At β = 3, a fixed smooth strongly convex potential has an open basin of nonminimizing alternating limits. A separate result for C^{4} objectives treats a compact Morse–Bott minimum manifold, fixed α > 3, β = √s and 0 < sL ≤ 1/4. A moving normal-history metric and a clock-weighted Lyapunov function capture all sufficiently close independent starting pairs and give finite travel to an unspecified minimum. All four regimes retain the actual predictors, old-gradient correction and finite negative-inertia prefix. Classical interpolation, momentum, perturbation and invariant-manifold ideas are credited. The conclusions concern these explicit certificates and their stated domains, without a sharp parameter threshold or a comprehensive novelty claim.
limitation: 没有求解2与3之间的精确边界。 局部流形结果与一维正反结论相对独立，叙事需梳理。
reasons: 给二次模型稳定而固定光滑强凸目标交替失败的开放初值反例，并在另一个超旧充分界参数给全局收敛。
说明IGAHD真实非线性稳定性不能从二次谱条件推断，正反结果有清楚联系。
原时钟误差捕获、有限早期满射回拉、全局图能量及局部Morse–Bott处理均非单纯极限矩阵分析。
主要正反结论为一维固定α、β、s，局部流形分支条件更强；不是完整参数相图。
强凸、平底和局部流形分支完整，但两个β值之间的临界点未求出。

originalTitle: Sharp normal stability and finite actual travel for reciprocal-clock IGATH-2
abstract: We study the literal fixed-step inertial gradient recursion with unregularized gradient history and reciprocal Tikhonov regularization near a compact C^{5} minimum manifold. A collision-safe rational metric gives the sharp normal band 0 < H < 8 and a self-contained capture proof with independent-history entry transients. On this common foundation, a moving stable and unstable phase bundle yields finite actual travel under Morse or Morse–Bott geometry, including approached saddle components and all tangent velocity modes. The same actual-map forcing identifies full vector Morse bias, moving-base transverse bias, and exact center and travel-tail constants; a uniform prepared circle realizes the k^{−1/2} tail. A parallel one-sided Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz argument allows degenerate critical sets, using a proved transfer from the restricted squared norm to a cubic-clock energy and giving desingularizer and power tails. At H = 8, an exact quadratic example has a positive product-normalized consecutive-pair limit and explicit growth envelopes under both clocks. All capture and selection statements retain the original integer index and their local entry hypotheses.
limitation: 没有任意早期初值捕获。 不能把主临界点选择当作全局最小范数选择。
reasons: 在原时钟上给锐正常区间0<H<8、有限实际行程及完整向量偏差，超过仅证明临界集捕获。
把局部稳定、选点几何与实际路径收敛联结，解释连续近似不能直接提供的偏差和边界增长。
碰撞安全度量、移动双曲分解、相位敏感误差及单侧KL转移有较深技术内容。
适用于C⁵紧最小值流形，但需晚时刻小历史进入；有限长度分支另需Morse–Bott或KL条件。
严格谱范围、端点失稳、偏差与固定圆例相互完整，证明边界清楚。

originalTitle: Secondary selection at the critical clock of the literal IGATH-2 recursion
abstract: For the literal IGATH-2 recursion with fixed gradient step 1/4, the critical schedule h_{k} = k^{−1/3} makes the normal-stiffness drift act for infinite harmonic time. Near a compact C^{5} minimum manifold of a C^{5} objective with normal spectrum in [µ, L] ⊂ (0, 8), we prove late-history capture using a collision-safe normal metric and a cumulative-transient velocity barrier. A Morse–Bott reduction of the restricted squared norm then yields an actual center step grad_{S} ψ/(6k) + O(k^{−4/3}), where ψ = ⟨N p, H^{−1}N p⟩/2, together with summable normal-history errors. Secondary values converge and every cluster point is critical without a gradient inequality. An additional one-sided Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz condition on −ψ|_{S} gives a single point limit and finite length of both actual paths. On a variable-stiffness circle, a separate uniform argument selects the minimum-stiffness point from every compact subarc away from the maximum, with fixed-entry rate O(k^{−1/54}) and a finite signed scaled limit. The same prepared history has different limits under the reciprocal and critical schedules. All entries and estimates retain the original global indices.
limitation: 不分类整个相空间吸引域。 解析流形本身不足以保证柔度势解析或幂KL。
reasons: 识别临界k⁻¹/³时钟诱导的柔度次级漂移，并在真实离散系统证明其系数与选点后果。
说明主最小范数势退化后，正常刚度仍能改变最终选择；比单纯减小误差常数更有概念内容。
临界非可和误差的重新捕获、两次正常滤波、移动分支和平坦KL处理较深。
C⁵紧流形、严格正常谱带及条件进入；次级单点收敛还需KL，圆例有不选择最软点的精确例外。
主/次级漂移、KL有限长度、固定圆例和1/54幂率互相支持，未越过进入条件。

originalTitle: Global convergence and period-three orbits for geodesic operator Sinkhorn
abstract: We study global convergence of geodesic operator Sinkhorn with a fixed relaxation parameter. For a positivity-improving real Kraus map between matrix sizes n, m ≥ 2, put r = max(m, n). Every positive-definite initialization converges projectively when 0 < ω ≤ r/(r − 1) and r ≥ 3. For square size two, the sharp universal interval is 0 < ω < 2; for square size three, it is 0 < ω ≤ 3/2. The positive proof uses the trace potential on determinant-one representatives, an exact noncommuting spectral profile, and strict descent at the endpoint. For every fixed 3/2 < ω < 2, we construct a positivity-improving 3 × 3 Kraus map and a prescribed start whose normalized orbit approaches a three-cycle that attracts a neighborhood within the diagonal invariant subspace. One instance has entirely rational map and initial data. The higher-dimensional sufficient bound is not claimed optimal.
limitation: 更高维阈值没有对应尖锐反例。 全空间三周期吸引盆地未证。
reasons: 为原测地过松弛算子Sinkhorn给出只依赖维数的全局区间，并在三维用真实三周期证明普适端点尖锐。
区分局部允许ω<2与全局收敛，回答自然的参数范围问题。
非交换谱剖面下降、端点严格性及有理Kraus映射的周期盒证书构成非平凡链条。
正结果覆盖正性改善映射和所有正定初值；反例吸引性只在对角不变子空间，不能宣称全空间稳健。
全局正定轨道、归一化、端点与反例相互配套；高维尖锐性未解决。

originalTitle: Boundary convergence of planar Burg and matrix entropy mirror descent
abstract: We study boundary convergence and selection for exact fixed-step mirror descent. For polynomial objectives that may be nonconvex, Burg descent on a planar affine simplex slice converges to one stationary point, while radial binary entropy descent on any finite-dimensional ball has finite Euclidean length. The latter is a finite-length theorem for all complex Hermitian two-by-two density matrices. For polynomials that are convex on the entire Hermitian matrix space, in arbitrary finite matrix size, we prove convergence to the unique initial-relative-entropy minimizer among the constrained loss minimizers. The result allows singular solutions and includes inconsistent quadratic data. The proofs retain the actual discrete recurrence: tangential dual coordinates handle polygon edges, a sphere-gradient dissipation estimate handles entropy balls, and a polynomial estimate controls accumulated gradients to prove matrix selection without boundary reciprocity. Explicit trajectories exhibit nonisolated boundary limits, noncommuting updates and rank-deficient selected states.
limitation: 二维Burg结论不能推广成任意维。 矩阵全空间多项式凸性比只在密度域凸更强。
reasons: 针对三种边界退化几何分别证明点收敛或有限长度，超出仅有镜像能量下降。
触及屏障核边界与奇异密度矩阵的实际极限问题，具有明确理论用途。
平面移动切向壁、球面提升和相对熵投影是不同的非平凡证明机制。
Burg部分限二维仿射截面；径向熵覆盖任意有限维球；矩阵部分要求整个Hermitian空间上凸的多项式。
三个完整模块存在共同边界问题，但尚无统一覆盖全部Legendre核的定理。

originalTitle: Boundary geometry and convergence of the literal B-adaPG method
abstract: We organize rigorous boundary results for the literal two-branch B-adaPG controller of Ou, Latafat and Themelis. An explicitly admissible Legendre kernel, flat on a boundary face, gives actual bounded nonconvergent trajectories with more than one optimal cluster point. The construction applies both to the original controller and to its prescribed fixed mild damping. Arbitrary initial stepsizes, exact asymptotic amplitudes, and the complete undamped basin classification are included. We distinguish these algorithmic counterexamples from the underlying failure of a boundary separation implication. Positive results are proved for regular composite objectives with bounded-ball strongly convex kernels, and for kernels continuous and strictly convex only on the feasible set, with an unchanged ambient controller and arbitrary closed convex constraints. We also prove cumulative-step divergence, an affine-split convergence result, a compatibility result identifying cluster gradients, and exact scalar, coupled and marginal entropy rates. All source-theorem comparisons concern arXiv:2508.01353v2; equivalence with the inaccessible journal main text is not asserted. The general unique-minimizer question outside the stated positive subclasses remains unresolved.
limitation: 不反驳原文最优子列或内部解保证。 若拆成多篇重复展示同一核，会明显稀释独立价值。
reasons: 合法平边Legendre核上的实际轨道反例定位了边界分离缺陷，且保留余项恢复若干正结果。
纠正指定公开版本的唯一最优聚点及轻阻尼断言，影响对自适应Bregman收敛保证的理解。
从完整共轭控制器推出真实增长分支和全聚点区间；边界屏障修复与熵渐近均非形式计算。
反例为特制二维核、零面积盆地；正结果覆盖较广复合几何，但不是任意核的统一收敛。
反例、盆地、阻尼和多种可恢复条件形成完整理论链条，附加速率部分略显分散。

originalTitle: A unique-minimizer nonconvergence example for undamped adaptive Bregman proximal gradient
abstract: We construct a two-dimensional Legendre kernel and a globally smooth convex objective with a unique minimizer for which the literal undamped ambient B-adaPG controller generates a nonconvergent orbit. The kernel is finite and continuous on a closed rectangle, has positive definite Hessian in its interior, and satisfies the full boundary Bregman-zone assumptions. The objective is x^{2} + y. An explicit infinite construction of its conjugate forces infinitely many exact excursions to first coordinate 1/2, each followed by an exact return to zero. Every stepsize is selected by the original controller from a specified positive initial pair. All forward probes, joins, and tail dependencies are verified. The example concerns compact-interior relative smoothness; boundary-uniform relative smoothness fails. It is compatible with a unique optimal cluster point and makes no claim about a damped rule or an uninspected journal formulation. No novelty claim is made.
limitation: 只涉及未阻尼版本。 不能据此判定P031同一固定核的长期行为。
reasons: 在固定合法核与唯一极小点目标上构造实际自适应轨道的最优和非最优双聚点。
精确否定唯一极小点自动保证全点收敛的推断，给恢复定理划出必要边界。
双空间无限胶合保留既往查询与控制器选择，是实质构造困难。
仅未阻尼算法及特制二维核；并未证明一般核失败或固定阻尼仍失败。
反例链条完整，但机制与P028边界退化高度相关，应一起阐释。

originalTitle: Slow and geometric terminal rates for scalar AdGD2
abstract: The terminal behavior of the original scalar AdGD2 rule depends sharply on the structure of the minimum. For every prescribed positive sequence r_{k} → 0, one fixed convex C^{∞} objective with derivative Lipschitz constant exactly one and unique minimizer zero has a convergent trajectory, initialized by x_{0} = α_{0} = 1, whose terminal gradient is neither O(r_{k}) nor O(1/k). The same construction gives arbitrarily slow terminal objective gaps, while preserving weighted gradient-square summability. In contrast, for a finite convex C^{1} objective with locally Lipschitz derivative g(x) ∼ ax^{p} at its unique minimizer, where a > 0 and p ≥ 3 is odd, every positive initial step gives either finite termination or exact geometric terminal equivalents. We prove from the actual adaptive minimum that the curvature candidate is eventually infinite, the sign is eventually constant, and α_{k} ∼ Aq^{k} with A > 0 and q = (1 + √(11/3))/2. The iterate, gradient and objective equivalents have respective bases q^{−1/(p−1)}, q^{−p/(p−1)} and q^{−(p+1)/(p−1)}. The finite-order result needs only a derivative-value asymptotic; it does not assume a second-derivative asymptotic.
limitation: 高维速率机制未覆盖。 任意慢构造的特殊性限制对典型性能的解释。
reasons: 同一实际AdGD2算法下，固定C∞凸目标可任意慢，而有限奇阶平坦目标出现精确几何渐近。
揭示末迭代量不能由最小或平均复杂度推断，并解释自适应方法在某些平坦点为何加速。
无限平台构造兼顾未来查询不扰动及全轨道收敛；几何正结果需控制实际非自治分支。
结论限标量；几何部分要求有限奇阶，排除线性阶与多维耦合。
负例与正渐近对照清楚，三类末迭代量均有具体含义。

originalTitle: Attracting Cycles and Critical Invariant Curves in Practical Adam-SHANG
abstract: For the practical scalar Adam-SHANG recurrence we prove a nonminimizing quadratic two-cycle, its exact fixed-curvature stability interval, nonlinear attraction at the oscillatory threshold, and a supercritical Neimark–Sacker branch consisting of two exchanged attracting curves. A fully specified quartic polynomial gives a direct critical Lyapunov certificate. Exact interval arithmetic also certifies convergence from a zero-momentum initialization. The results concern the practical parameterization, not a contradiction of the source’s separately conditional convergence theorem.
limitation: 局部参数族不解释大多数实际训练。 ε随周期族曲率改变，不能误称固定设置普适失败。
reasons: 保留实际Adam-SHANG滞后状态后，给出周期族、精确临界参数、闭曲线分岔及临界吸引证书。
说明实际参数设置可产生非优化吸引子，对区分算法设计与条件定理有意义。
四维正规形、临界四次Lyapunov多项式及常规初始化的严格进入认证相互补充。
固定标量确定性目标和指定参数族，未覆盖随机、高维或通用Adam。
周期稳定、分岔及启动组成完整局部动力学研究；不同参数的启动证书没有混用。

originalTitle: Terminal phases, regularity thresholds, and generic noncapture for AdGD2
abstract: We study the literal AdGD2 controller with its published initialization. On a scalar quadratic every infinite run is captured in finite time by an admissible nonconstant stepsize two-cycle. For a nonflat scalar minimum, Dini continuity of the Hessian yields limiting controller phases and geometric primal decay; a log-Dini condition yields nonzero pure-geometric amplitudes. We construct a fixed strongly convex C^{2} objective with continuous non-Dini Hessian and nonconvergent step parities, and another with a Dini but non-log-Dini Hessian whose geometric amplitudes degenerate through an explicit polynomial prefactor. A source-initialized cubic superlinear orbit realizes the centered controller phase. Finally, on diag(1, 2), for every fixed mixed direction all but countably many initial steps avoid capture and have nonconvergent steps, although the primal iterates converge. These are controller and terminal-rate conclusions, not failures of the source convergence theorem.
limitation: 二维结论的模型一般性有限。 算法特定的代数性质较重。
reasons: 建立AdGD2相位的Dini与log-Dini分界，并构造阈值反例及二维泛型步长不收敛。
澄清自适应步长的极限比原变量收敛更细且依赖正则性。
有限捕获、固定函数插值、加权误差尾和及代数赋值排除需多种实质工具。
标量局部理论较广，二维泛型结论仅指定二次模型，不能推广所有维数。
正结论、尖锐反例及二维障碍形成较完整分类。

originalTitle: Spectral asymptotics and converses for accelerated quadratic iterations
abstract: Bach conjectures three pointwise asymptotic regimes for a discrete accelerated quadratic iteration with exact power-law spectral data. We prove the stated equivalents and constants for every fixed positive real momentum parameter and every positive spectral dimension in the finite-energy formulation. A fixed asymptotically equivalent monotone spectrum shows that the Stieltjes data alone do not determine the pointwise constant. We then give sharp perturbation-stability thresholds and an exact interval for the possible logarithmic-boundary coefficients, attained by a fixed monotone spectrum. For zero-start Nesterov regularization on an arbitrary Hilbert-space operator, we characterize all-iteration norm rates strictly above semisaturation by weak spectral tails, giving the stronger source index asked for by Kindermann with the classical range-endpoint epsilon loss. At semisaturation itself, the exact condition is bounded weighted mass on moving logarithmic spectral intervals. This condition lies strictly between the strong source condition and the weak spectral-tail bound. The converse proofs use uniform averages of the actual squared residuals, including the compact Bessel transition.
limitation: 没有噪声停止规则等价结论。 经典Gegenbauer/Bessel工具不是本稿原创。
reasons: 完整区分精确谱、渐近等价谱及Stieltjes条件，并给尖锐扰动阈值与无噪逆定理端点。
说明加速迭代渐近常数受到谱相位影响，完善优化谱分析与逆问题源条件的联系。
整数谱振荡抵消、固定谱拼接、统一Bessel下界及移动环带必要充分性均有实质难度。
逆结论覆盖一般谱测度，无须离散谱或谱隙；精确渐近部分仍限定幂律谱和特定滤波器。
正渐近、稳定阈值、尖锐坏例和逆刻画相互支撑，两个研究语境需要清楚组织。

originalTitle: The exact final gradient curve of constant step gradient descent
abstract: For a convex function with an L-Lipschitz gradient, we prove that the exact worst-case norm of the gradient after N constant steps of size h/L, under an initial-distance bound R, is LR max{(1 + N h)^{−1}, |1 − h|^{N} } for 0 ≤ h ≤ 2. This establishes the smooth-convex specialization of the final-gradient conjecture of Taylor, Hendrickx and Glineur. Existing objective and gradient bounds settle all even horizons and part of the odd-horizon range. A scaling argument transfers the known balanced history certificate to the progress branch. We close the remaining odd-horizon strips by continuing a published factorization and correcting at most two adjacent interpolation pairs with nonnegative squared norms. Every coefficient sign is proved uniformly in the horizon. The two classical scalar examples attain the bound. A direct Moreau-envelope corollary gives the corresponding exact relaxed-proximal residual curve.
limitation: 正强凸全曲线未解决。 已有平衡证书是重要依赖，必须明确归属。
reasons: 闭合光滑凸固定步GD的全步长、全时域末梯度精确曲线，净新困难集中奇数时域离平衡条带。
回答基础算法明确的最坏性能问题，具有比特制轨道更广的基准意义。
离平衡历史证书的修正和通用系数正性不是数值PEP检查即可替代。
任意维光滑凸、N≥1和0≤h≤2，但不含正强凸曲线。
全参数覆盖、可达例及边界均闭合，来源与直接推论范围需保留清楚。

originalTitle: A curvature dependent lemniscate method for terminal gradients
abstract: We give a horizon dependent first-order method for the terminal gradient of a smooth strongly convex function. Its coefficients are determined by a unique scalar boundary-value problem that deforms the known convex lemniscate recurrence. The method uses two vector accumulators and N gradient evaluations to construct its output. An explicit rank-two interpolation certificate proves a gradient-norm bound with factor τ_{N} (µ/L). A fixed quadratic attains this bound, so the factor is the exact worst-case value for the constructed method. It decreases strictly with the curvature ratio and reduces to the convex lemniscate factor when µ = 0. On an explicit positive-curvature interval, it improves three specified bounds obtained from convex class inclusion and existing ITEM variants. No minimax optimality among competing methods is claimed.
limitation: 核心路径明显依赖既有凸结构。 比较区间窄且没有全方法下界。
reasons: 将凸lemniscate路径改成曲率依赖射击，并从真实累加器建立秩二精确证书。
改善指定弱强凸区间的末梯度保证，提供可计算的新方法。
边值唯一性、路径反射、所有指标的行和及秩二分解构成完整算法设计。
所有0≤µ/L<1有限时域可用；优势比较仅指定小曲率窗口，不是全部方法最优。
算法、精确自身最坏界和比较齐全，但正强凸的极小极大下界及长时线性率未证。

originalTitle: No uniform vanishing last iterate bound for exact Polyak steps
abstract: For every prescribed number of updates, we construct a convex continuously differentiable function of two variables and an initial point at distance one from its unique minimizer. Both the function and its gradient have global Lipschitz constants at most one. Ordinary Polyak steps, using the exact optimal value and the actual squared gradient norm, produce a terminal function gap greater than 1/40. Thus no class-uniform last-iterate bound tending to zero holds under these assumptions. The construction prescribes an exact backward itinerary for a quadratic ratio map and uses a conjugate extension to bound the gradient globally. Each run uses a single fixed objective; the objective and initialization depend on the horizon. We compare the result with Theorem 2.3 of the public preprint arXiv:2407.15195v1, identify the incompatible equal-gradient-norm reduction, and give an explicit finite-horizon contradiction to its displayed bound. The result is consistent with fixed-instance convergence and best-iterate guarantees.
limitation: 函数依赖N，不能宣传为固定光滑反例不收敛。
reasons: 给固定归一化光滑凸函数类任意时域的精确Polyak末点常数下界，而非仅一次上升。
直接修正具体公开版本的普适末迭代界，并澄清固定实例收敛与统一复杂度的差异。
反向安排末步与全局光滑凸延拓保持真实轨道，是主要构造难点。
二维已足够，但每个N选择不同曲率和初值，不给同一函数的无限非收敛。
有明确有限反驳与固定实例说明；一般正下界类的分类未展开。

originalTitle: Deterministic power law acceleration of optimistic gradient
abstract: We prove deterministic last-iterate acceleration of ordinary optimistic gradient on finite-dimensional biaffine saddle problems. A binary radical-inverse power-law schedule gives a residual bound of order T^{−1/β} for every fixed 3/2 < β ≤ 8/5, with a sufficiently small explicit base step. In particular, the exponent 33/50 is valid with a concrete fixed base. The schedule, scalar logarithmic integral and derandomization principle are based on prior extragradient work. The new transfer controls the ordered optimistic-gradient product by pairing each large step with a neighboring base step in a frequency-dependent energy. Its additional logarithmic error is a monotone tail moment and can be absorbed uniformly. We include a self-contained special-case quadrature proof and treat every prefix, zero singular values and the actual last iterate. The result uses the unchanged optimistic-gradient recurrence and makes no assertion about the larger base step used in the motivating experiment or about optimality among optimistic-gradient schedules.
limitation: 步长较激进，非线性稳健性未证。
reasons: 将双仿射OG的较弱随机几何均值分析升级为单一确定性无限步长表的全前缀控制。
不知总时长即可得到幂律加速，为不交换历史矩阵提供有效分析。
Pareto积分、单侧低差异求积及非交换传递配对共同闭合。
任意有限维矩形双仿射鞍点，无需谱隙；不能推广为一般非线性单调算子。
实际初始历史、所有前缀与零模态完整，β范围和基步保守。

originalTitle: Sharp stepsize results for reflected gradient
abstract: For unconstrained reflected gradient, we prove weak convergence for every globally monotone L-Lipschitz map on a real Hilbert space with a zero throughout 0 < λL < 1/√3, from arbitrary two-point initialization. An energy that is coercive on actual histories removes a boundedness or summability premise from earlier results. We then prove weak convergence to a variational-inequality solution for every bounded orbit of the exact projected recurrence with an affine monotone operator, throughout the same range. Both first and second differences are square-summable, and the original graph, tangent, and natural residuals vanish. On compact convex sets in finite dimensions, convergence is in norm. Its proof combines five projection inequalities, an exact polynomial certificate, a finite-horizon estimate retaining every boundary term, and the standard forward-reflected-backward distance energy. The inherited rotation example attains the endpoint even on the unit disk. Both results concern the specified recurrence; neither enlarges the universal range of a general maximal-monotone backward splitting.
limitation: 仿射投影的有界性不是自动结论。
reasons: 取得反射梯度无约束普适尖锐阈值，并在有界仿射投影轨道上给同阈值。
扩大清楚的一次算子调用方法步长区间，边界反例同时限制进一步改进。
只在实际历史上强制的能量及投影频域证书避免任意变量正定性过强要求。
无约束覆盖Hilbert单调Lipschitz；投影分支限仿射并假定实际轨道有界。
正结果与端点障碍匹配，明确不声称一般非线性投影。

originalTitle: A finite-history obstruction to Lyapunov certificates for alternating gradient descent–ascent
abstract: A recent study of projected alternating gradient descent–ascent proposes a homogeneous finite-history Lyapunov linear matrix inequality and reports approximate numerical feasibility. We prove that its exact feasible set is empty for every finite history and every positive stepsize. More directly, for each history length we construct a genuine initialized trajectory on compact convex polytopes, with a symmetric positive definite norm-one operator, whose two consecutive history Gram matrices agree while an admissible comparator gap is positive. Hence the specified quadratic history potential cannot satisfy the required one-window descent inequality, even without a positivity requirement on the potential. The construction uses an exact finite sine-moment system and normal-cone inequalities. This obstruction does not disprove an averaged convergence rate for the algorithm, the source’s conditional theorem, or its separate matrix-game theorem.
limitation: 不否定非二次证书或只比较鞍点的势。
reasons: 对每个有限历史长度构造真实投影轨道，排除指定整个二次Gram证书类。
界定自动Lyapunov搜索可能永远无解的情形，避免把搜索失败误认算法不收敛。
矩系统、Vandermonde与法锥实现共同确保不是不可实现的抽象Gram反例。
任意历史和任意正步长，但维数随历史增长，且比较点必须可任取可行点。
否定对象及量词完整；不排除别种比较点、非二次或无限历史证书。

originalTitle: A strict saddle basin for Schedule-Free gradient descent
abstract: We construct a fixed C^{∞} coercive function on R^{2}, with globally 1-Lipschitz gradient and exactly three nondegenerate critical points, for which standard unperturbed Schedule-Free gradient descent converges to a strict saddle from an open set of position initializations. The momentum parameter is 9/10, the step size is 1/2, and the averaging coefficient is 1/(k + 1). Every phase map after the first update is a global diffeomorphism, and the initialized surface retains rank two at every finite time. The construction places an interval of initialized states on an exact decaying solution of the local negative-quadratic recurrence. A finite affine interpolation and an even mollifier realize all required queries in one globally smooth objective. An explicit energy controls the positive-quadratic coordinate. The example realizes the initialization obstruction in existing perturbed saddle-avoidance analyses; it concerns the initialized surface and does not assert attraction from an open set of ambient phase states.
limitation: 开放盆地范围与相空间范围不同。 不证明任意参数有此现象。
reasons: 构造固定平滑强制目标，使标准位置初始化的开放集在Schedule-Free下趋严格鞍点。
为无扰动标准初始化避鞍提供实质反面证据，说明相空间零测定理的限制。
非自治稳定线、有限梯度胶合和全局光滑性同时约束，构造难度较高。
特制二维函数与固定参数；开集属于位置初始化面，不能改称整个四维相空间吸引盆地。
全局函数、所有临界点、标准初值及严格证据完整。

originalTitle: Mean-logistic large-step bounds: an exact counterexample and valid repairs
abstract: We give an admissible zero-start counterexample to the literal mean-logistic averaged-iterate bound in a pinned published theorem: the actual risk exceeds 397 where the claimed upper bound is below one. We isolate the inverse-mean convexity error, establish a parameterized sample-size delay, prove the valid exponential analogue, and repair asymptotic convergence of the unchanged logistic algorithm using a convex sum transform. Finite guarantees are proved for explicitly specified best and weighted outputs, with the remaining arithmetic-average and last-iterate limitations made explicit.
limitation: 大步长反例不代表通常小步长训练。 首次分离不自动成为永久分离。
reasons: 给均值logistic逆变换凸性的真实反例及零初值平均输出反驳，并提供可成立修复。
揭示样本数依赖与均值/总和归一化在大步长理论中的实质差异。
饱和区严格误差、样本数延迟及替代凸势构成完整修复链。
可分归一化数据、任意正步长的渐近结论较广；有限反例采用高度不平衡样本。
错误定位、真实轨道及渐近和输出修复配套；书目题名需修正。

originalTitle: Uniform two-parameter selection in critical raw gradient descent
abstract: For a three-variable polynomial objective, exact simultaneous gradient descent at a critical stepsize selects a minimizer according to a uniform square-root law. We prove all-time capture and point convergence for a two-parameter family, allowing the nonzero transverse perturbation to be arbitrarily small relative to the tangential displacement. The transverse coordinate never vanishes at finite time and alternates in sign. A stopped-orbit estimate controls the entire accumulated error, including the potentially long residence near an unstable minimizer. The limiting-point map is discontinuous along the positive tangential axis. The argument is analytic and requires no numerical prefix or uniform convergence-time estimate.
limitation: 不能据二阶统一界断言固定s穿孔极限唯一。
reasons: 将单参数尖点提升为统一双参数选点，控制任意小噪声与偏移比值。
揭示临界稳定边界附近终端映射的非一致性和不连续机制。
全时间捕获不能依赖噪声下界，非线性近守恒量及正侧逃离需要额外闭合。
同一固定三变量模型的局部初值族，尚无模型类定理。
统一展开和b=0区别清楚，固定正s穿孔极限是否存在未解。

originalTitle: Almost sure covariance escape for scalar Gaussian ensemble Langevin discretization
abstract: For every fixed ensemble size N ≥ 2, fixed step size η > 0, and finite positive initial covariance, we prove almost-sure convergence of the empirical covariance to positive infinity for the untamed forward Euler ensemble Langevin scheme with a one-dimensional standard Gaussian target. We derive its exact (N − 1)-dimensional Gaussian covariance kernel from the particle update, retaining the divisor N in the covariance. A Gaussian logarithm inequality supplies strictly positive boundary drift even when N = 2. Fractional inverse moments exclude eventual trapping near zero; a uniform positive escape probability and conditional-probability martingale convergence then give almost-sure escape from every positive start. The proof is analytic and self-contained apart from standard conditional-expectation convergence. Zero covariance is absorbing. No escape rate, particlewise conclusion, or novelty claim is made.
limitation: 不说明发散前时间尺度或稳定替代法。
reasons: 将标量协方差正概率坏行为提升到所有正初值的几乎必然完整逃逸。
说明固定步显式系综Langevin在最简单高斯目标下也长期失稳。
高斯对数下界、边界逆矩与全滤过逃逸闭合，不只是大状态漂移。
所有N≥2和正步长，但仅标量且零协方差是吸收例外。
有限时合法性及完整趋无穷均证明，矩阵推广由P061承担。

originalTitle: Almost sure spectral covariance escape for Gaussian ensemble Langevin discretization
abstract: For every fixed positive step size and every nondegenerate Gaussian target in finite dimension, we prove that the largest empirical covariance eigenvalue of the untamed ensemble Langevin Euler scheme converges almost surely to positive infinity from every deterministic full-rank initial ensemble. The admissible ensemble size is N ≥ d + 1, and covariance is normalized by N . A measurable top eigenvector gives a Rayleigh lower bound with a conditionally standard Gaussian innovation. This bound is one-sided; the largest eigenvalue is not assigned a scalar Markov transition. A self-contained Gaussian logarithm lemma, including the two-particle scalar case, yields an inverse-moment contraction near zero. Conditional escape estimates and a martingale argument in the full particle filtration then establish the almost-sure limit. The source’s rectangular covariance factor gives exact affine conjugacy. We separately prove rank preservation and spectral escape for nonzero singular ensembles under the same literal recurrence, outside the source’s full-rank state space. No conclusion about lower eigenvalues, determinants, individual particles, centroids, or rates is asserted.
limitation: 只证明最大特征值逃逸。 不能换成另一平方根噪声实现后直接沿用。
reasons: 将所有非零可行协方差的几乎必然逃逸扩展至任意维高斯目标及奇异初态。
对广泛实际粒子离散指出固定步长期稳定性的结构障碍。
可测顶特征向量、条件Rayleigh下界和秩保持解决非Markov最大特征值难点。
任意维数、粒子数可行秩、正步长和非退化高斯目标；依赖指定噪声因子与校正项。
矩阵与标量逻辑完整，清楚区分最大特征值逃逸和全部谱逃逸。

originalTitle: Convergence of scalar ADMM with dual steps below two
abstract: We prove convergence of the scalar alternating direction method of multipliers with an unchanged pair of primal updates and any fixed dual step 1 < γ < 2. Both objective functions may be arbitrary proper closed convex functions, provided a primal-dual solution exists. The proof applies to every pair of scalar nondecreasing 1-Lipschitz maps with a fixed point of the coupled iteration. Its central estimate places each dual iterate in a convex hull determined by the preceding two dual iterates. This gives boundedness and uniform stability, and a quantitative two-step decrease proves absolute summability of the feasibility residuals. An extremal-coordinate argument shows that every compact set mapped onto itself contains a fixed point, and stability then yields convergence of the whole orbit. The result concerns scalar blocks and does not assert convergence for general vector-valued ADMM.
limitation: 维度1是本质技术限制。
reasons: 对两个任意标量近端映射将纯对偶ADMM步长收敛范围推进至2，并给有限变差。
跨过常见黄金比例界，清楚说明标量保序可绕开通用二次能量障碍。
三点凸包和两步耗散控制残差绝对可和，证明结构可解释。
任意标量闭凸目标、存在KKT；不能推广为一般向量ADMM。
全轨道、稳定常数及端点周期/发散界配套。

originalTitle: A sharp objective bound and a residual counterexample for Douglas–Rachford splitting
abstract: For smooth-first unrelaxed Douglas–Rachford splitting, we prove the exact terminal objective bound ∥w^{1} − w^{⋆}∥^{2}/(4γN ) whenever the convex smooth term has Lipschitz gradient constant L and 0 < γL ≤ 1. The second term may be any proper closed convex function with a compatible primal–dual solution. This establishes the unrelaxed small-step part of a recent composite-objective conjecture. The proof expands an explicit weighted interpolation certificate into nonnegative squares for every horizon. A classical proximal-point example attains the constant. For a separate operator-residual conjecture in the same source, we give a two-dimensional rational cocoercive counterexample at horizon fourteen and a family with squared residual asymptotic to 1/(5eN ) at its chosen horizon. The latter examples use the established averaged-rotation mechanism and have no convex-gradient representation.
limitation: 不是一般余强单调算子的目标定理。
reasons: 建立smooth-first DR尖锐末点目标常数，并独立否定更广余强单调残差猜想。
为基础分裂法提供精确终端保证，且解释梯度结构不能从算子假设中省去。
全N插值权重及正半定分解完整，不依赖有限数值PEP。
一般凸光滑加闭凸复合，γL≤1；残差负例是非梯度算子，二者不能互换。
上界、取等和独立算子反例齐全，强凸或更大步长未解决。

originalTitle: First- and second-order implementations for negatively comonotone problems
abstract: We give two implementations of the anchored extra-proximal framework of Jiang and Yoon through the classical monotone graph transformation for negative comonotonicity. For a composite inclusion, a prescribed finite contraction meets the relative-error condition using only original operator values and backward resolvents. For every strict admissible margin, its accelerated first-order oracle bound has no accuracy logarithm. For a smooth equation with a Lipschitz Jacobian, we give a second-order implementation using original value–Jacobian queries and known linear systems. A finite prefix, independent of the requested accuracy, supplies a guaranteed lower line-search bracket. At fixed known model parameters and a supplied initial-distance bound, the total second-order query count has accuracy dependence O(ϵ^{−2/5} log(2 + 1/ϵ)), in addition to the explicit prefix cost. Every trial and linear solve is counted. The graph transformation, acceleration energy, second-order exponent and search architecture are inherited; the implementation estimates connect them to the stated original oracles.
limitation: 裕度接近零的常数和前缀很大。 二阶计算量与一阶oracle不可直接平均比较。
reasons: 把已有负共单调加速框架落实为原始oracle的固定内循环及有限Newton搜索。
避免隐藏精确转换resolvent和未计内迭代，使理论复杂度真正对应可实施查询。
相对误差、全前缀和非单调搜索函数的有限括区需要具体闭合。
一阶覆盖pairwise rL<1包含；二阶另需Jacobian Lipschitz及已知参数，不等于弱Minty。
原始调用、矩阵求解和前缀代价均计入，指数来源明确。

originalTitle: Point convergence of IREG-PRM+ without equilibrium uniqueness
abstract: For the strict current-state shifted-extragradient IREG-PRM^{+} recurrence in a finite zero-sum matrix game, we prove that the entire strategy sequence converges to one Nash equilibrium, even when the equilibrium is not unique. Li and Huang already establish bounded regret norms and vanishing last-iterate gaps, but leave possible drift within the equilibrium set unresolved. The additional argument uses the existing regret accounting geometry: pairing the cumulative regret states with any fixed equilibrium gives a bounded nondecreasing scalar. At an equilibrium cluster point this scalar attains its limiting Cauchy–Schwarz bound, which forces the whole state sequence to converge. We specify the zero-state convention and include a self-contained account of the global ingredients. The result covers boundary equilibria and never-positive regret states. It assumes no strict limiting spectral condition and gives no rate.
limitation: 初始化和归一化规则不能随意更改。 文献行号应修正。
reasons: 去掉IREG-PRM+均衡唯一性，以固定均衡配对的取等结构证明单点选择。
覆盖任意有限矩阵零和博弈，解决非唯一均衡漂移这一明确问题。
单调配对和范数预算联合闭合简洁有效，基础几何已有。
不需内点、严格互补或局部谱，但限定原规则和零状态初始化。
预策略、实际策略及累积状态均收敛；无速率，引用零分支行号需改。

originalTitle: Energy decay and iterate nonconvergence for Lyapunov damping
abstract: We prove a full-energy bound of order log^{4}(k)/k^{2} for the normalized Lyapunov damping gradient iteration on smooth convex functions with an attained minimum, without assuming boundedness of the orbit or sublevels. The estimate holds for every fixed step 0 < s ≤ 1/L, including equality, and has an explicit initial-data constant. A bounded initial sublevel improves the bound to O(k^{−2}). A fixed scalar convex function with Lipschitz gradient and bounded sublevels has an equal-start orbit whose cluster set is an entire minimizer interval; on that same orbit, both energy and objective fail to be o(k^{−2}). For the unnormalized continuous law, every given global classical solution satisfies an explicit O(log^{4}(t)/t^{2}) energy bound without a radius assumption, while bounded solutions satisfy O(t^{−2}). A scalar quadratic has t^{2}E(t) → 4 and objective scaled limsup 4 and liminf 0. The unbounded-orbit endpoints without logarithmic loss are not established.
limitation: 一般无界子水平的无对数端点未证。 原始连续与归一化离散阻尼不能混用。
reasons: 给原Lyapunov阻尼离散的能量速率及无半径对数损失界，严格证明整段极限集。
澄清自适应能量衰减与迭代点收敛的差别，补指定版本的速率问题。
正辅助能量、能量分层与无限穿越/返回构成不同证明难点。
一般凸光滑有解，无有界子水平假设仍有较弱速率；非收敛例一维平底。
离散与连续正反结果完整，去掉log⁴的端点仍未解决。

originalTitle: Attracting invariant curves in strongly convex heavy ball dynamics
abstract: We construct fixed smooth strongly convex potentials on R^{2} whose heavy ball dynamics undergo supercritical Neimark–Sacker bifurcations. The first example has momentum 1/2 and a two-cycle at step 1. The second has momentum 9/10, global Hessian bounds I/101 ⪯ ∇^{2}f_{3} ⪯ I, and a prime three-cycle at step 7/2. Its bifurcation lies strictly inside the stability region for every quadratic with the same bounds, with margin 3/10 at the critical step. For the one fixed potential f_{3}, varying the step produces three disjoint attracting invariant curves cyclically permuted by the physical map. We give the complete global potential, derive its local jets from the defining minimization, and calculate the actual moving-cycle crossing and a strictly negative cubic coefficient exactly. The classical invariant-curve theorem supplies local attraction in the full four-dimensional state space. Attracting finite cycles and the bifurcation theorem are prior results; the construction verifies their nonlinear compatibility within a fixed globally admissible potential. No irrational-rotation or equal-position initialization claim is made.
limitation: 未证明闭曲线动力学普遍准周期。 缺乏参数图谱和典型初始化结论。
reasons: 在固定全局C∞强凸势下构造重球周期分岔出的吸引闭曲线，超出已有有限周期例。
说明所有同类二次稳定的参数内仍有非线性吸引动力学，凸性不足以解释重球行为。
全局凸jet实现、Moreau包络、移动周期及真实三次系数全部闭合。
二维势、两组特制参数和局部分岔，不给典型目标统计或全初值分类。
全局函数合法性与全相空间吸引已证，标准初始化可达范围仍有限。

originalTitle: Boundary circulation for an inertial projection scheme
abstract: We study the fixed-step recurrence x_{n+1} = P_{C}(2x_{n} − x_{n−1}) on a compact planar convex body with C^{5} boundary and strictly positive curvature. Every sufficiently close distinct boundary pair generates a trajectory that preserves its orientation and circulates indefinitely. Its increments vanish, while its position limit set is the entire boundary. If ℓ is the perimeter and I is the boundary integral of squared curvature, then the squared chord increment satisfies n∥x_{n} − x_{n−1}∥^{2} → ℓ/(2I). Both accumulated arclength and chord length grow as √(2ℓ/I)√n, and the iteration-sampled positions converge in distribution to normalized arclength. The proof derives a uniform cubic phase loss from the actual metric projection and establishes averaging by summation by parts. The recurrence and its artificial damping belong to earlier impact and position-projection schemes; the result concerns their fixed-step long-time boundary dynamics.
limitation: 高维和任意初始化未覆盖。 全部数值阻尼优先文献未穷尽。
reasons: 对任意严格正曲率平面边界给惯性精确投影的全边界循环与精确经验测度。
将一个不收敛例提升为几何类的长期定量规律。
局部三次损失与真实相位平均连接，给出曲率积分常数。
任意C5严格凸平面曲线，但初始需邻近同向边界对，非任意初态或高维。
衰减、长度、完整极限集和等分布互相支持，来源优先性仍未穷尽。

originalTitle: Lyapunov functions for semi-implicit dynamics with nonlinear friction
abstract: We study a semi-implicit gradient system with pure power friction. One modified energy gives two results under distinct assumptions. Near a compact Morse–Bott minimum manifold it yields small-energy capture, finite length and convergence to one minimum. With global Hessian and Hessian-Lipschitz bounds, a structural step restriction gives coercivity and descent from every original phase, without minimum geometry or an assumed bounded orbit. This implies boundedness, summable velocity and gradient powers, and a connected critical limit set; global point convergence is not asserted. The proof adds the friction potential to a standard symplectic correction and sums two successive energies. A sign estimate controls arbitrary velocities, and quadratic and cubic force-remainder bounds give global absorption. The conservative correction and finite-step construction are inherited. A separate scalar example with mixed linear–cubic drag and quartic potential admits direct physical-energy descent for one fixed step interval and every initial phase, despite unbounded curvature. A further scalar C^{4} strongly convex class with pure friction |v|^{3/2}v admits arbitrary-phase convergence under an explicit structural step bound. A physical-energy cap first gives global capture; an exact cubic correction and a finite observation window then give local dissipation. A continuous strict global function is obtained from finite future entry segments. For mixed radial drag, a further physical-energy estimate treats any positive-leading quartic polynomial in finite dimension, including nonconvex potentials with unbounded negative curvature. A coefficient-only step bound yields arbitrary-phase capture, a common compact absorbing sublevel and approach to the critical set.
limitation: α=3/2全局定理仅标量。 多分支难以视为单一广泛框架。
reasons: 对缺二次摩擦下界的半隐式原映射建立局部捕获和全局分支，并处理超二次纯摩擦及四次势。
克服已有KL离散理论的耗散非退化与轨道球步长限制。
反射Bregman余项、非物理修正能量及有限物理时长可观测性具有可复用性。
五个分支分别附Morse–Bott、全局导数或标量强凸条件，不构成任意F和D的通用定理。
每个模块证明完整，但内容较散，固定多项式例应并入主结构。

originalTitle: Lyapunov decay and a nonconvergent cold-start orbit with integral feedback
abstract: We give a fixed analytic planar potential for an existing gradient system with integral feedback. Its published Lyapunov function is proper on the full phase space and decreases along every trajectory. Nevertheless, every sufficiently small positive displacement in one explicit zero-velocity, zero-memory family generates a bounded nonconvergent position orbit. Its full phase limit set is the circle of minimum equilibria. In the original time variable, the angle is asymptotic to √t, the velocity and memory norms to 1/(2√t), and the energy to 1/(8t). The proof combines energy capture with a smooth asymptotic-phase projection and an exact positive quadratic memory coefficient. The equation, energy, invariant-manifold tools, and general nonconvergence phenomena are inherited; the result is an exact cold-start realization with these physical-time constants.
limitation: ρ*没有显式数值，1/100只保捕获。 应用来源匹配仍未确认。
reasons: 解析强制势的积分反馈系统从真实零速度零反馈启动仍可产生整圆极限。
说明解析势加严格能量耗散不足以将含额外记忆的系统套入普通梯度点收敛。
正常吸引图和光滑相位投影需计算冷启动二阶记忆，不能自由指定中心流形初值。
一个固定六维系统、局部一参数冷启动族，不覆盖所有积分控制器。
完整相位极限集与精确慢速常数均证；与宣称来源算法的补充资料未核。

originalTitle: Lyapunov decay and zero-dissipation orbits in damped AVF systems
abstract: We study the distinction between physical-energy dissipation and strict Lyapunov control for partially damped average-vector-field systems. A fixed-step example has a globally coercive nonincreasing energy, an explicit locally strict quadratic energy, and a cold periodic orbit of zero numerical dissipation, although its continuous dynamics converge globally. We then construct a different single real-analytic, globally strongly convex potential with bounded Hessian. Its implicit map is unique at every positive step, and one explicit local quadratic energy is strict for all steps in (0, 1]. Nevertheless, a sequence of steps tending to zero admits exact cold periodic orbits whose initial energies tend to infinity. Thus no one small-step threshold guarantees convergence from every phase for that potential. No failure on a fixed compact family of starts is asserted. Both constructions retain the numerical invariant-set qualifications in the established passivity theory.
limitation: 周期随h趋零逃向无穷。 既有半全局结果尚未逐篇全文对照。
reasons: 单个解析强凸势在步长趋零时仍有逃向无穷的冷启动周期，否定全相空间统一阈值。
明确结构保持的耗散恒等式不能替代离散可观测性。
整函数无限节点、全局Hessian界、真实积分周期与统一局部能量同时实现。
部分阻尼二维AVF且两套指定势；不否定任意固定紧初值集的小步长保证。
局部稳定、连续全局稳定和离散周期的区别完整。

originalTitle: A sharp universal product threshold for Chambolle–Pock period-three orbits
abstract: For the literal primal-first Chambolle–Pock map with any nonnegative extrapolation parameter, we determine the smallest stepsize product that permits a nonconstant period-three orbit. Necessity holds for arbitrary proper closed convex functions, arbitrary finite-dimensional real Hilbert spaces, and arbitrary linear couplings, without a saddle-point assumption. A centered-triple shift identity, two cyclic subgradient inequalities, and a Gram bound reduce the proof to an ellipse support calculation. Planar indicator functions attain the bound with an existing saddle point and an explicit paired-state initialization. This strengthens the restricted ordered-triangle optimality result of report 18. It is a universal period-three threshold, not a universal convergence threshold. No novelty claim is made.
limitation: 排除三周期不排除高周期、无界或非周期失败。 与P005/P004共享实例，必须去重。
reasons: 从几何单例提升为所有有限维凸CP三周期的精确必要且可达阈值。
严格界定一种最短非二次失稳机制，并揭示一段小外推区间内二次边界并非普遍安全。
中心化移位、正交相关量及Bessel约束把任意几何压缩成椭圆问题，论证简洁而非依赖大规模证书。
必要性允许任意维数、耦合和闭凸函数，甚至不需鞍点；只研究周期3。
全θ≥0的必要性、等号实现与边界均闭合，研究问题明确完整。

originalTitle: An exact two-mode characterization of Chambolle–Pock five-cycles
abstract: We give an exact second-order-cone feasibility characterization of the stepsize products admitting a nonconstant five-periodic orbit for the literal primal-first Chambolle–Pock recurrence. The necessity argument applies to arbitrary finite-dimensional real Hilbert spaces, arbitrary linear coupling, and arbitrary proper closed convex functions. Conversely, every feasible point yields explicit indicator functions in dimension eight, a least-period-five orbit, an actual initialization, and a saddle point. All eight cyclic interpolation inequalities are retained; no rank condition or unverified interpolation constraint remains. Exact certificates exclude products at most 31/10 when θ = 1/8 and at most 17/10 when θ = 1, while explicit two-mode examples exist at 25/8 and 7/4, respectively. The certificates use only rational arithmetic in Q(√5). These are certified brackets, not sharp scalar thresholds or a global convergence result. No novelty claim is made.
limitation: 固定五周期，基本定理被P011覆盖。 粗认证区间被P013的精确端点加强。
reasons: 把五周期存在性精确化为两个SOC模态，而非仅给必要条件；后续P011已推广任意周期。
使非规则混合频率失稳可计算并可实现，对推进锐阈值研究有用。
真正难点是任意Gram锥点的合法近端实现及全部法锥约束，没有遗漏函数插值。
全θ≥0及任意有限维凸目标和耦合，但周期固定5。
等价和认证区间完整；两个例子的精确端点由P013补充，当前稿不声称已求端点。

originalTitle: A finite-history convergence certificate for Chambolle–Pock at θ = 1/8
abstract: For the literal primal-first Chambolle–Pock iteration with extrapolation parameter 1/8, we prove boundedness, square summability of first differences, and weak convergence to a saddle point whenever τ σ∥L∥^{2} ≤ 148537/50000 = 2.97074. The result holds on arbitrary real Hilbert spaces for proper lower-semicontinuous convex functions, a nonempty KKT set, and arbitrary initial points. A finite-history storage inequality, certified by 126 explicit rational coefficients, supplies both actual-history coercivity and strict descent. Its constant-history scalar quadratic is positive definite. The convergence proof uses only its positive diagonal entries and the vanishing coupling pairing on differences of KKT points to separate weak cluster points. All coefficients and exact positive-definiteness pivots are printed; an independent original-map checker accompanies the source. The bound is sufficient, not asserted sharp, and leaves a gap to the known three-cycle obstruction.
limitation: 界非已证锐界，大有理数证书缺少简洁解释。 相邻稿部分更强声明待确认，不能当作已证覆盖。
reasons: 在θ=1/8给约2.97074的可复核一般耦合收敛保证；有限历史自动证书的通用思路已有。
明显改善已核显式充分界，且为本批若干曲率证明提供独立可靠的低乘积基础。
证书之外还完成实际图强制性、一般算子嵌入、正指标函数值及弱极限闭合，不能只看126个数字。
任意实Hilbert空间和一般有界L、两个闭凸目标，允许初值在函数定义域外；θ固定。
全部有理系数和检验信息在PDF内，自足；未达到可能的最大安全范围，也未给更广参数公式。

originalTitle: Exact attained five-cycle thresholds for primal-first Chambolle–Pock dynamics
abstract: We determine the least-period-five existence thresholds for the literal primal-first Chambolle–Pock map at extrapolation parameters 1/8 and 1. The thresholds are algebraic numbers of degree twelve, approximately 3.114241184076725 and 1.730020332057708, respectively. Each is specified by an integer polynomial and a certified rational isolating interval. Exact algebraic endpoint witnesses and strictly positive dual certificates prove that the feasible products are precisely the closed upper rays starting at these numbers. Necessity applies to arbitrary finite-dimensional real spaces, proper closed convex proximal functions, and linear couplings, using the actual operator norm. Endpoint constructions use convex-hull indicators in R^{8} and have a saddle pair. We include the complete eight-inequality Fourier–SOC reduction, the realization proof, the active-face matrices, and portable exact certificate checkers. This is a finite-cycle existence result; no global convergence or originality claim is made.
limitation: 两切片不构成全θ五周期相图。 与P010/P011的主体等价机制重叠。
reasons: 对两个θ切片得到实际达到的精确代数五周期阈值，提升P010的认证区间；不是新的通用周期框架。
示范混合频率如何产生规则多边形无法直接给出的精确极值，并可作为判据求解的基准。
活跃面、锥铅笔、Sturm根隔离与正对偶证书联合证明全局最优，技术链完整。
凸目标和维数不受限，但只给两个固定θ和周期5。
下界、可行端点、最小周期、所有更大乘积均已证，不只列出数值根。

originalTitle: Lyapunov energies for inertial Tikhonov selection
abstract: We give Lyapunov arguments for minimum-norm selection in discrete inertial dynamics with vanishing Tikhonov regularization. For a constant-inertia backward-penalty scheme, a coercive moving-center energy absorbs the constraint normal through the implicit Fitzpatrick pairing and yields strong convergence without selected-point interiority or bounded normal selections. For a proximal inertial trajectory with damping of order n^{−q}, 0 < q < 1, we treat the critical regularization exponent q + 1 for every proper closed convex objective with a nonempty minimizer set in finite dimensions. A first trajectory energy derives boundedness without coercivity from existing velocity estimates. A second energy then yields minimum-norm selection, including unbounded minimizer sets. A third, explicit recurrence retains a gradient-history correction and a reciprocal Tikhonov term. For one fixed IGATH-2 specialization on finite-dimensional convex C^{2} objectives with globally 1-Lipschitz gradients and an attained minimum, a coercive phase energy first proves boundedness; a moving-center energy then yields minimum-norm selection. A fourth, composite recurrence retains a proper closed convex nonsmooth term. For a fixed IPGATH-1 specialization, a first phase energy proves boundedness after proximal domain entry; a moving-center energy controls the gradient lag and yields minimum-norm selection. The four recurrences and their hypotheses are distinct. Classical pairing, inertial weights and scalar convergence tools are credited; the conclusions concern the actual trajectories.
limitation: 四种算法并非一个统一定理的特例。 全局IGATH证明采用指定参数，不是全部参数稳定区。
reasons: 贡献分别是常惯性罚项能量、临界近端选点及两个指定Hessian阻尼算法的有界性与强选择，不能全部称首个Tikhonov收敛理论。
填补若干真实离散算法的选点论证，尤其先有界再用紧性的闭合有价值。
Fitzpatrick处理法向项与移动中心能量需要细致估计，但大部分工具已有。
第一部分为Hilbert单调包含，后三部分有限维且参数固定；四部分的范围不可相互移植。
各证明完整但研究问题分散；应按算法/问题重组，而非用四定理数量体现统一理论。

originalTitle: Boundary-uniform relative smoothness and unique-minimizer convergence of B-adaPG
abstract: We prove convergence of the original undamped B-adaPG method when its convex objective has a unique minimizer and relative smoothness is uniform on bounded interior sets approaching the kernel boundary. No strict convexity on the feasible closure is required of the kernel, the finite proximal term, their sum, or the objective. A retained smooth defect in the exact energy inequality yields a scalar separation principle and a cumulative-stepsize excursion argument. All cluster gradients then agree, allowing a unique-minimizer endpoint trap for the reverse Bregman distance. Large-step endpoints and descent at small steps give objective convergence and finally point convergence. Initialization is arbitrary and the full ambient controller is unchanged. An affine proximal term and nonlinear forward term illustrate the result on a flat boundary kernel. The stronger smoothness hypothesis remains essential to this proof; the corresponding question under only compact-interior relative smoothness is not settled here. No novelty claim is made.
limitation: 内部局部相对光滑不能代替所需边界统一性。 不解决P031的指定二次光滑分裂。
reasons: 在平边核允许退化时，以边界一致相对光滑及唯一总极小点恢复原算法全轨道收敛。
为边界反例提供可检验的充分条件，区分优化目标唯一与几何分离失效。
散度屏障和加权缺陷处理可能极小或极大的实际步长，闭合不是标准Fejér论证。
不要求g严格凸，但f需在可行域邻域C1凸，且相对光滑常数须覆盖边界。
正结论连同散度、目标和梯度极限完整；必要性及最优参数仍缺。

originalTitle: Sequential convergence of AdaGrad-Norm under local smoothness
abstract: We prove that scalar AdaGrad-Norm converges to a minimizer of every finite-dimensional convex function with full domain, locally Lipschitz gradient, and an attained minimum. Both the learning rate and the positive initial accumulator are arbitrary. The accumulator has a finite limit, and the squared gradient norms are summable. The proof uses a fixed ball around one minimizer: the current-gradient normalization places an auxiliary point in that ball, even before boundedness of the actual iterates is known. A threshold argument and an exact logarithmic product then establish accumulator boundedness. A coupled noncoercive example has super-polynomial gradient growth and satisfies no global generalized-smoothness bound. The result concerns the scalar accumulator; it does not settle the corresponding coordinatewise or full-matrix questions.
limitation: 只证明序列性质，无统一速率。 多维矩阵预条件器的非交换问题仍未处理。
reasons: 将AdaGradNorm整列收敛放宽到一般局部光滑凸函数，去除全局增长控制并允许任意正参数。
覆盖非强制且不满足全局(L0,L1)增长的自然凸问题，扩大明确收敛保证。
通过固定辅助球获得局部梯度控制，再闭合全局对数预算，避免循环使用轨道有界性。
任意有限维凸C1、局部Lipschitz梯度且达到最小值；只适用于标量累积AdaGradNorm。
短文有完整闭合及超出旧条件的例子，未给速率，也未扩展矩阵累积。

originalTitle: A Source-Initialized Period-Four Controller in Adaptive Nesterov Iteration
abstract: We analyze the literal window-one practical adaptive Nesterov rule of Hu, Pollock, Xue and Zhu on a scalar positive-definite quadratic. An exact interval certificate proves an attracting period-four normalized controller, selected by the printed initialization, while the primal iterates converge geometrically. The result holds for every fixed curvature in [0.7499, 0.7501]. At curvature 3/4 we give sharper cycle and rate enclosures. A coexisting stable normalized fixed point, source indexing qualifications, and the limits of the comparison with exact-spectral-radius theory are included.
limitation: 参数窗口很窄。 尚无周期窗口形成机制的普适定理。
reasons: 认证源初始化下控制器真实四周期及原变量的精确相位渐近。
反驳参数估计必稳定到常数的直觉，而未否定优化变量收敛。
全参数闭区间、记忆初始化和相位乘积均需严格证书。
仅标量二次、狭窄曲率区间及一个指定初始化规则。
连续参数稳健性及另一共存定点完整，但不构成一般控制器分类。

originalTitle: Critical and Period-Two Controller Dynamics in Monomial RMSProp
abstract: For the next-gradient variance ordering of RMSProp, we give exact critical-parameter asymptotics for the quartic trajectory initialized at (x_{0}, v_{0}) = (2, 64), a constructive local theorem for every even monomial degree, and a certified sextic initialization. We also prove phase selection and positive parity-dependent physical amplitudes for a quartic controller two-cycle below the critical parameter. Finite-prefix certificates use outward-rounded rational arithmetic. Physical convergence already present in the source is distinguished from the sharper initialized asymptotic statements proved here.
limitation: 一般偶次的全部初值进入性未证。 与最终出版版本的细节差异未完全排除。
reasons: 将边界极限控制器的翻转分岔落实到真实方差耦合轨道，并处理临界n⁻¹/²相位。
明确控制器慢振荡和物理变量几何收敛可以共存。
真实两步陷阱、有限前缀认证和方差无穷乘积避免边界模型代替原算法。
无ε、下一梯度更新的标量偶次单项式；不可泛化为所有常用RMSProp实现。
一般偶次局部进入定理配有四次、六次启动例及二周期例。

originalTitle: Scalar TM-free Feedback Exact Supporting Convergence and Cycle Exclusion Results
abstract: We study the scalar feedback subsystem of the printed TM-free algorithm, preserving its initialization, temporal-secant controller, and one-step extrapolation lag. The controller freezes after finitely many changes on every infinite defined strongly convex smooth trajectory. We give quadratic stability and exact rational exclusions of nonconstant period-three and period-four frozen or limiting cycles. For a relaxation retaining only consecutive secant bounds, the joint spectral radius is exactly r√(1 + 2r). This yields a conditional convergence regime, while its extremal alternating mode violates scalar gradient interpolation. A separate rational function-value certificate proves geometric convergence at m = 1/25, µ = 1/50, beyond the temporal-only stable regime. Complete proofs and exact certificate data are provided. General convergence from the printed initialization remains unresolved. The source leaves an output coefficient and zero-secant branch undefined; neither is silently completed here.
limitation: 一般非线性全局收敛仍未知。 源算法完整定义也有待澄清。
reasons: 给冻结反馈能量、短周期排除及时间割线矩阵族精确联合谱半径。
识别任意切换矩阵界与可由单一函数实现的轨道之间的差别。
空间排序Farkas证书和谱字分解精确，处理了弱序与实际插值约束。
仅标量TM-free且每次商有定义，源算法未定义分支不在结论内。
支持性结论完整，但一般初始化收敛的中心问题没有解决。

originalTitle: Endpoint residual bounds and fixed step benchmarks for flexible extra anchored gradient
abstract: For the flexible extra-anchored-gradient method of Boţ and Chenchene, we consider the endpoint schedule ε_{k} = 1/[θ(k + β)]. A signed quadratic estimate upgrades the established residual bound O(k^{−1+δ}), valid for every δ > 0, to O(k^{−1}). The method and its step-size range remain unchanged. The argument uses the prior weaker estimate only to make an error series summable. A scalar strongly monotone example shows that o(k^{−1}) cannot hold in general. We also give a fully explicit, conservative bound in terms of the parameters and initial and anchor distances to a chosen zero. These distances need not be known by the algorithm. For initial anchoring and β = 1, we also give finite-dimensional fixed-step benchmarks: a horizon-dependent skew family forces a normalized residual constant of at least 2, and a five-step scalar estimate yields a uniform fixed-step lower constant 5/2 in the L-normalized scale, compared with the known full-step FEG constant 2. No matching sharp upper constant or broader parameter comparison is claimed.
limitation: 自足显式常数较保守。 不产生比全部既有锚定法更快的算法。
reasons: 将原柔性锚定外梯度的k⁻¹⁺δ残差补到O(1/k)，并给固定实例排除小o。
闭合自然端点速率问题，并说明指定固定步长方案相对已有FEG常数的局限。
有符号能量上界与另一自足显式预算结合，避免错误要求能量非负。
一般单调Lipschitz算子及全部正锚定参数，有限前缀也受控。
上界、固定实例下界和公平算子预算比较齐备；常数并非最优。

originalTitle: Global facet selection for accelerated velocity constraints
abstract: We study accelerated optimization with velocity constraints on an affine polyhedron, using the original selected-constraint method of Muehlebach and Jordan. Suppose that the objective is globally smooth and strongly convex, and that exactly one defining inequality is active at the minimizer, with a positive multiplier. From every feasible zero-velocity start, we give an explicit index after which that optimal inequality is selected at every step. The proof retains the strict quadratic remainder in the existing energy argument and uses a signed energy to exclude all late returns to the feasible side of the optimal facet. It gives global boundedness and an accelerated Lagrangian-gap bound with the actual incoming velocity. An explicit later index guarantees that all other inequalities are inactive and the optimal velocity inequality binds permanently. A quadratic refinement and the failure of Lyapunov stability describe the scope of these conclusions.
limitation: 单一严格活跃面限制实际普适性。 全轨迹吸引不等于边界选择规则下的Lyapunov稳定。
reasons: 对原速度约束加速算法给全局永久单面选择、实际进入时间及二次尾部速率。
处理活动集切换不连续，区分最终绑定与有限抵达可行边界。
带符号能量、回返排除及实际进入速度保留是核心难点。
全局强凸光滑、多面体但最优点只允许一个严格正乘子活跃面。
全局到局部链条完整；多面同时活跃和退化乘子未覆盖。

originalTitle: A three coordinate energy bound for random permutation coordinate descent
abstract: For every real positive definite 3 × 3 matrix with unit diagonal, we prove a one-epoch energy contraction bound for exact coordinate descent under a uniform random permutation. If σ is the smallest eigenvalue, the factor is max{1/4, (1−σ)^{2}}. The proof reduces the energy deficit to three scalar polynomial inequalities and gives an exact rational Bernstein certificate over four explicitly covering boxes. The certificate has 1,595 coefficients, all nonnegative, and is regenerated directly from the six coordinate-update products. The result implies the dimension-three case of Kim–Lee–Yun’s ICML 2025 conjecture and a strict asymptotic mean-square advantage over uniform sampling for almost every initialization. No assertion is made about dimensions four or higher or the optimal factor.
limitation: 四维以上尚未建立。 有限证书展示需便于读者理解结构。
reasons: 解决随机置换坐标下降三维子问题，给比渐近欧氏率猜想更强的单轮能量界。
对小维非交换随机乘积提供可核验的正结果，但不解决一般维猜想。
相关矩阵不变量化和全域有理Bernstein证书有设计含量，系数数量本身不计深度。
任意三维SPD可归一化，维数固定为3是主要限制。
六个真实更新及全域闭盒证书完整；可推广机制尚不清楚。

originalTitle: Directional transitions in an accelerated gradient restart system
abstract: We study the accepted restart states of a specified accelerated gradient method on a two-parameter family of strongly convex quadratic functions in R^{2}. The method uses the strict gradient-angle test and the reject-and-recompute rule of Bao, Chen, Li and Shen. Although every accepted point sequence converges geometrically to the minimizer, its normalized restart states have three different regimes. They converge to an eigendirection, form a two-cycle, or enter a regime with periodic directions or two closed arcs as their limit set. We derive the exact return map from the original iteration, including its switching equalities. In the third regime the restart intervals are 3 and 4, and their frequencies are given by a logarithmic rotation. For each fixed second eigenvalue, every frequency in (0, 1) is realized by exactly one parameter. An explicit rational quadratic gives an irrational frequency and a non-eventually-periodic restart word. The rotation arguments are classical; the result is their exact realization and parameter classification for the stated restart rule.
limitation: 没有对一般非二次目标给稳健结论。
reasons: 将真实拒绝重算重启算法约化为方向返回映射，得到三种明确方向状态。
说明点收敛并不意味着重启频率或方向稳定，可解释事件时钟的复杂性。
精确接受/拒绝多项式及圆周旋转结构是核心；二维线性模型仍较专门。
固定二维对角二次及指定参数楔形，非一般重启加速算法。
事件、点收敛和字面梯度成本闭合，不把不同重启实现混用。

originalTitle: Mechanical energy for a gradient-corrected restart system
abstract: We study a two-step gradient iteration with a gradient-difference correction and a varying extrapolation coefficient.
